extracted.intended_audience: outstanding researchers (and UK university research/HR administrators) seeking or administering Royal Society salary-enhancement awards
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and eligibility/award rules for the (now-archived) Royal Society Wolfson Research Merit Award: who could apply, what the award funded, tenure and payment arrangements, and scheme status. Useful for applicants and host universities assessing fit and obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheme purpose / target audience
rubrics_metrics.description: This scheme was for outstanding scientists who would benefit from a five year salary enhancement to help recruit them to or retain them in the UK.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The scheme provided universities with additional support to enable them to recruit or retain respected scientists of outstanding achievement and potential to the UK by providing a salary enhancement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — employment status
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants were eligible to apply if they held a permanent post at a university in the UK or had received a firm offer to take effect from the start of the award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be employed (permanent post) in the UK university sector or have a firm offer that begins when the award starts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — salary funding source
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants were eligible to apply if their basic salary was wholly funded by the university.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The applicant's basic salary must be entirely paid by the host university (i.e., not externally funded) for eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award duration / tenure expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: The scheme provided up to five years of funding, after which the award holder continued with a permanent post at the host university.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The award is a five-year salary enhancement; the expectation is continuation in a permanent university post after the funded period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award value — salary enhancement amount
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The principal component funded was an annual uplift to salary; typical enhancement amounts were in the stated range.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment mechanism / host university responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The scheme provided universities with additional support ... by providing a salary enhancement which is paid by the university in addition to the basic salary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The host university is responsible for paying the enhancement on top of the applicant's basic salary (i.e., award funds support the university to provide that uplift).

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding partners
rubrics_metrics.description: The scheme was jointly funded by the Wolfson Foundation and the Royal Society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the award's financial backing and partnership; may affect branding, reporting or administrative arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheme status / availability
rubrics_metrics.description: This award will no longer receive applications and has been superseded by the Royal Society Wolfson Fellowships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page is archived; the scheme is closed to new applications and applicants should consult the successor Fellowship scheme for current opportunities.
